desc: Precompute binomial coefficients C[n][k] for n up to 1000 modulo 10^9+7
For each middle index i with value v, count vl, vr, and build freqL/freqR for non-v elements
Compute pick2_nonv_distinct for each side and for cross-side (left+right) picks of 2 non-v with distinct values
Compute pick3_nonv_distinct for picking 3 non-v elements with all distinct values
Compute k=4, k=3, k=2, k=1 contributions and sum modulo 10^9+7
Fix the k=1 formula: correct correction terms are freqL[x]*freqR[x]*((R-vr)-freqR[x]) and freqR[x]*freqL[x]*((L-vl)-freqL[x]), not C-based terms
Fix the pick3_nonv_distinct formula: use ((L-vl)-c) instead of (c-2) in the correction
Test additional edge cases: n=5 boundary, large arrays, values with negative numbers
